t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Nothing appears to change the mushroom amount at least not on the background of the picture. Participant looked at cloud and chimneys and windows. Suggested looking at something else

vb_textbox.text: So I struggled to see a pattern. In general it felt like shorter gnomes gave more mushrooms so maybe experiment with that. I think each colour of gnome has a different value and depending which side theyre standing on might affect their value too. Short and green seemed to be less valuable than blue. There doesnt seem to be anything that changes in the background so I think its something to do with the gnomes, their colour and position. I think the multiplier may also change the pattern but I am definitely not sure of this. Im sorry this probably isnt much help but I hope it gives you something to test and play with.
